Ruth, I couldn't set up the 07:45 brief, so nothing is scheduled yet.

The scheduler rejected my request with a gateway credentials error: "requires credentials… configure gateway.auth token/password, pair this device". I don't want to tell you it's running when it isn't. Someone who manages the OpenClaw gateway will need to fix that first. Once they have, ask me again and I'll create it.

The brief itself is workable:
- **Access:** you're a member of #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. Everyone in #strategic-random (you, Gideon Sato and Nadia Fennimore) is also in the other two channels, so the brief won't show anyone anything they couldn't already read.
- **Plan:** a daily post in this channel at 07:45 Central, starting tomorrow (Oct 15). It would summarise new messages from the three channels.
- **Finance figures:** the brief will leave out rates, prices, contract values and payment terms, and say "finance details omitted" instead. The exception is a figure already posted in #strategic-random.
- **Direct messages:** it will never include anything from DMs.
